description: NaCdAlF₆ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded to six F atoms to form distorted NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent CdF₇ hexagonal pyramids, corners with five equivalent AlF₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent CdF₇ hexagonal pyramids, and edges with two equivalent NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 53-55°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.56 Å. Cd is bonded to seven F atoms to form distorted CdF₇ hexagonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaF₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent AlF₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent CdF₇ hexagonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one AlF₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 51-53°. There are a spread of Cd-F bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.35 Å. Al is bonded to six F atoms to form AlF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent CdF₇ hexagonal pyramids, corners with two equivalent AlF₆ octahedra, corners with five equivalent NaF₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one CdF₇ hexagonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-55°. There are a spread of Al-F bond distances ranging from 1.78-1.85 Å. There are six inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Cd and one Al atom. In the second F site, F is bonded to one Na and three equivalent Cd atoms to form FNaCd₃ tetrahedra that share corners with three FNaCd₃ tetrahedra and edges with four FNa₂AlCd tetrahedra. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Al atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Cd, and one Al atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Cd, and one Al atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₂AlCd tetrahedra. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent Al atoms.
